reasoning: Base ratings: the Suns are -0.8 and the Clippers -0.3 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Suns 3.2 better here, total 227.
Rest, travel and availability move it 0.9 towards the Clippers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Suns by 2.3, 57% to win; total 225 (80% range 201-249).
